controles.web: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
controles.kjv: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Palavras do Pregador, filho de Davi, rei em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל׃

controles.web: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
controles.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
controles.livre: Futilidade das futilidades! - diz o Pregador - futilidade das futilidades! Tudo é fútil!

versos.hebraico: מַה־יִּתְר֖וֹן לָֽאָדָ֑ם בְּכָל־עֲמָל֔וֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?
controles.kjv: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
controles.livre: Que proveito tem o homem de todo o seu trabalho que ele trabalha abaixo do sol?

versos.hebraico: דּ֤וֹר הֹלֵךְ֙ וְד֣וֹר בָּ֔א וְהָאָ֖רֶץ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֹמָֽדֶת׃

controles.web: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.
controles.kjv: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
controles.livre: Geração vai, e geração vem; porém a terra permanece para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְזָרַ֥ח הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּבָ֣א הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְאֶ֨ל־מְקוֹמ֔וֹ שׁוֹאֵ֛ף זוֹרֵ֥חַֽ ה֖וּא שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
controles.kjv: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
controles.livre: O sol nasce, e o sol se põe; e se apressa ao seu lugar onde nasceu.

versos.hebraico: הוֹלֵךְ֙ אֶל־דָּר֔וֹם וְסוֹבֵ֖ב אֶל־צָפ֑וֹן סוֹבֵ֤ב׀ סֹבֵב֙ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הָר֔וּחַ וְעַל־סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו שָׁ֥ב הָרֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
controles.kjv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
controles.livre: O vento vai ao sul, e rodeia para o norte; continuamente o vento vai rodeando e voltando aos lugares onde circulou.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אֶל־הַיָּ֔ם וְהַיָּ֖ם אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מָלֵ֑א אֶל־מְק֗וֹם שֶׁ֤הַנְּחָלִים֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים שָׁ֛ם הֵ֥ם שָׁבִ֖ים לָלָֽכֶת׃

controles.web: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
controles.kjv: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
controles.livre: Todos os rios vão para o mar, e contudo o mar não se enche; ao lugar onde os ribeiros correm, para ali eles voltam a correr.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים יְגֵעִ֔ים לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל אִ֖ישׁ לְדַבֵּ֑ר לֹא־תִשְׂבַּ֥ע עַ֨יִן֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְלֹא־תִמָּלֵ֥א אֹ֖זֶן מִשְּׁמֹֽעַ׃

controles.web: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
controles.kjv: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
controles.livre: Todas estas coisas são tão cansativas, que ninguém consegue descrever; os olhos não ficam satisfeitos de ver, nem os ouvidos se enchem de ouvir.

versos.hebraico: מַה־שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֔ה וּמַה־שֶׁנַּֽעֲשָׂ֔ה ה֖וּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין כָּל־חָדָ֖שׁ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

controles.web: That which has been is that which shall be; and that which has been done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
controles.kjv: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
controles.livre: O que foi, isso será; e o que se fez, isso será feito; de modo que nada há de novo abaixo do sol.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֛ר שֶׁיֹּאמַ֥ר רְאֵה־זֶ֖ה חָדָ֣שׁ ה֑וּא כְּבָר֙ הָיָ֣ה לְעֹֽלָמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה מִלְּפָנֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new?” It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.
controles.kjv: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
controles.livre: Existe algo que se possa dizer: Vê isto, que é novo?Isso já existia nos tempos passados, que foram antes de nós.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥ין זִכְר֖וֹן לָרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְגַ֨ם לָאַחֲרֹנִ֜ים שֶׁיִּהְי֗וּ לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ זִכָּר֔וֹן עִ֥ם שֶׁיִּהְי֖וּ לָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃פ

controles.web: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.
controles.kjv: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
controles.livre: Não há lembrança das coisas que já aconteceram; e das coisas que vão acontecer, também delas não haverá lembrança entre aqueles que vierem depois.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֣י קֹהֶ֗לֶת הָיִ֥יתִי מֶ֛לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Eu o Pregador, me tornei rei sobre Israel em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַ֣תִּי אֶת־לִבִּ֗י לִדְר֤וֹשׁ וְלָתוּר֙ בַּֽחָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם ה֣וּא׀ עִנְיַ֣ן רָ֗ע נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִבְנֵ֥י הָאָדָ֖ם לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
controles.kjv: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
controles.livre: E dei meu coração a investigar e pesquisar com sabedoria sobre tudo o que acontece abaixo do céu; esta cansativa ocupação Deus deu aos filhos dos homens, para que nela fossem forçados.

versos.hebraico: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֔ים שֶֽׁנַּעֲשׂ֖וּ תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכֹּ֛ל הֶ֖בֶל וּרְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
controles.kjv: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
controles.livre: Vi todas as obras que são feitas abaixo do sol, e eis que tudo é futilidade e aflição de espírito.

versos.hebraico: מְעֻוָּ֖ת לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לִתְקֹ֑ן וְחֶסְר֖וֹן לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל לְהִמָּנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
controles.kjv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
controles.livre: O que é torto não pode ser endireitado; o que está em falta não pode ser contado.

versos.hebraico: דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי אֲנִ֤י עִם־לִבִּי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֨ה הִגְדַּ֤לְתִּי וְהוֹסַ֨פְתִּי֙ חָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה לְפָנַ֖י עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלִבִּ֛י רָאָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה חָכְמָ֥ה וָדָֽעַת׃

controles.web: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”
controles.kjv: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
controles.livre: Eu falei ao meu coração, dizendo: Eis que eu me tornei grande, e aumentei em sabedoria, sobre todos os que tinham sido antes de mim em Jerusalém; e meu coração experimentou uma abundância de sabedoria e conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה לִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה וְדַ֥עַת הוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְשִׂכְל֑וּת יָדַ֕עְתִּי שֶׁגַּם־זֶ֥ה ה֖וּא רַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.
controles.kjv: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
controles.livre: E dei meu coração para entender sabedoria, e para entender loucuras e tolices; e percebi que também isto era aflição.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֛י בְּרֹ֥ב חָכְמָ֖ה רָב־כָּ֑עַס וְיוֹסִ֥יף דַּ֖עַת יוֹסִ֥יף מַכְאֽוֹב׃

controles.web: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
controles.kjv: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
controles.livre: Porque na muita sabedoria há muito aborrecimento, e aquele que aumenta em conhecimento aumenta em angústia.
